name: Distributor Management
one_liner: Distributor onboarding, secondary sales capture, stock and expiry visibility, schemes and claims.
fits_when: a manufacturer sells through a network of distributors or stockists
distributors must submit secondary sales and stock on a regular cadence
near-expiry stock needs to be seen by region, distributor and batch
trade schemes generate claims that area managers and commercial ops approve
distributors need their own login that shows only their own data
distributor KYC (drug licence, GST, agreement) is checked before activation
gives_you: Distributor onboarding with KYC documents, approval and an auto-created distributor login
Weekly secondary sales uploads with parsing, error rows, review and acceptance
Stock positions by product and batch with expiry buckets and near-expiry views
Schemes with regions, budgets and a launch-to-close lifecycle
Claims raised by distributors, approved by the area manager and validated by commercial ops
A distributor 360 page with sales, stock, near-expiry value, claims and an activity timeline

catalogue.description: A distributor management system for manufacturers that sell through distributors: onboard and KYC distributors, collect weekly secondary sales and stock from each of them, watch stock days and near-expiry by region, and run trade schemes whose claims move from the distributor through the area sales manager to commercial ops and on to SAP as credit notes. Distributors sign in to see only their own uploads, stock and claims.
